summary: Frontend-only regression for Lostly Phase 2 (4 routes, single-page report form, board filters, clue flow, status toggle, persistence, mobile responsiveness). All 12 requested feature areas verified via Playwright against the public preview URL. Every scenario passed with no console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js:27-29 — saveItems is only called `if (items.length)`; if the user deletes all items (not currently supported) or the seeded list is somehow cleared, state won't persist to localStorage. Minor since delete isn't a feature yet, but consider unconditionally saving once initial hydration is complete.

ReportForm.jsx sets `whenOption` default to '' and falls back to 'Not Sure' at submit; UI has an explicit 'Not Sure' chip but nothing is pre-selected, which could confuse users. Consider pre-selecting 'Not Sure' or highlighting default state.
ItemsBoard withinTimeFilter (in lib/lostly.js — not viewed) is applied even when timeFilter==='all'; ensure it short-circuits (small perf/style nit, likely already handled).
seed_data_creation: Test created one lost item titled 'TESTBlue Laptop' with a clue 'TESTclue near cafeteria' via UI; stored in localStorage key lostly_items_v1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the app base. Splash auto-navigates from '/' to '/home' in ~1.4s. All data-testids used are exactly as specified: category-btn-{ItemTypeId}, when-btn-{OptionLabel exactly including spaces}, filter-chip-{id}, time-chip-{id}, status-chip-{id}, item-clue-button-{itemId}, item-status-toggle-{itemId}, board-search-input, clue-modal-textarea, clue-modal-submit-btn. Note localStorage may already contain items from prior runs; seed only applies when empty.
